items.title: Work From Home / Rad od kuce
items.text: Teach online from your own space with no commuting and no office overhead. / Predaj online iz svog prostora bez putovanja i kancelarije.

items.title: Flexible Hours / Fleksibilno vreme
items.text: Choose your availability and build a schedule that fits studies or full-time work. / Odaberi dostupnost i napravi raspored koji odgovara studijama ili poslu.

items.title: Stable Opportunity / Dugorocna saradnja
items.text: Competitive compensation, international students, and structured support. / Konkurentna zarada, internacionalni ucenici i jasna podrska.
